meta_description: Elegant Touch Decorators in Manchester offers professional interior and exterior painting services. Reliable, quality finishes. Free quotes. Call today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert painting and decorating. Free quotes, no pressure, reliable service across Manchester.
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Fresh walls, ceilings, and woodwork that transform your living space. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint and varnish work for fascias, doors, and render. We protect your home whilst improving curb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional hanging of feature walls and complete room papering. We handle tricky corners and ensure seams are invisible.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Expert painting and varnishing of skirting, doors, frames, and fitted furniture. Smooth, durable finishes that handle daily use.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and restaurant redecorating completed on schedule and within budget. We work evenings and weekends to minimise disruption.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Faux effects, murals, and bespoke colour consultation. Create a truly unique look tailored to your home's style and character.

about_pullquote: We treat every room like we're decorating our own home.
about_para_1: Elegant Touch Decorators was founded in 2010 by a team of experienced painters frustrated with poor standards in the trade. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, honest pricing, and finishes that stand the test of time. We've completed over 500 projects across Manchester and South Lancashire, from Victorian terraces to modern apartments.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we plan carefully, and we leave sites spotless. We don't rush jobs or cut corners on preparation — the secret to a professional finish is the work you don't see. Every project comes with our satisfaction promise: if you're not happy, we'll put it right.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Craig and the team did our lounge and hallway. They were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. The prep work was thorough and you can see why the finish is so smooth. Highly recommend, will definitely book them again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior painting done before winter. Got a free quote within two days, price was fair, and they turned up on the exact date promised. Quality of work is excellent. No mess, no fuss. Top job.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Had them in to wallpaper two rooms and paint the rest. They moved all our furniture carefully, protected everything, and the finish is immaculate. Better than I expected. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Paul H.
